[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 7: Antagonist Guidelines[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]7.1[/color] Antagonists are held to a higher standard of roleplay, similar to Command.
[color=#a4885c]7.2[/color] Antagonists are expected to roleplay with others. This includes Security and Command.
[color=#a4885c]7.3[/color] The damage that an antagonist is allowed to cause must be proportional to their objectives.
[color=#a4885c]7.4[/color] Pirates should prioritize theft and ransoming, not murder and destruction.
- [color=#a4885c]7.4.1[/color] Pirates cannot force interactions which result in player or command bank accounts being robbed. (IE: demanding players withdraw funds for ransom)
[color=#a4885c]7.5[/color] Nukies should prioritize destroying the station and command. Non-combatants and freelancers should be ignored, unless they are threatening.
[color=#a4885c]7.6[/color] Revolutionaries want to take control of the station, not destroy it. Converting command should be at least attempted before murdering them.
[color=#a4885c]7.7[/color] Free agents, such as mice, rat-kings, wawas, and so on should only fight in self-defense, unless they are conscripted by a company.
